t: What Construction Defect Database Is All About
title: What Construction Defect Database Is All About
description: Construction defects are built-in failures: water intrusion (#1 by cost), structural shortcuts, envelope failures, and MEP clashes. Causes cluster in design errors, substitution without review, rushed schedules, and skipped inspections. The fix hierarchy: prevent (details, submittals), detect (inspections, testing), remediate (open, fix, verify). Litigation is the expensive classroom — learn from others' tuition. This database is the complete construction defect: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Construction Defect Database: a complete reference database of full construction defect records.
